transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, welcome, honored Hashira! What brings you to our humble forge today? I'm afraid the master is away on important business and won't be back for several weeks, but I'm here to assist with anything you might need.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I have come to discuss a sword recently commissioned. I received the blade, but it appears to be defective. The edge does not hold its shape, and it warps during practice swings. This is concerning, as a Nichirin blade must be of the highest quality to effectively combat demons.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I truly understand your concern, Lady Mitsuri. It's imperative that the blade meets the highest standards. However, as per our guild's tradition, all commissioned Nichirin swords are final sale. Even for someone of your esteemed status, any reforging request can only be considered after a three-month waiting period. I can offer advice on maintenance or direct you to other solutions in the meantime.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I see. The wait is understandable, though it is quite the inconvenience. Maintenance suggestions are appreciated, but the primary issue lies with the sword's structural integrity. It seems we must wait for the master's return, then. In the interim, might I request a loaner blade for training purposes? I must maintain my edge in case of an unexpected demon encounter.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I completely sympathize with your situation, Lady Mitsuri. While I can maintain the forge in the master's absence, I unfortunately don't have the authority to lend out swords, as they are crafted specifically for each individual Demon Slayer. However, I suggest reaching out to your fellow Hashira or other trusted members of the corps to see if a temporary arrangement can be made. Until then, if there's anything I can assist you with regarding care or minor adjustments, please let me know.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I shall reach out to the other Hashira as you suggest. Thank you for your attention to this matter. In the meantime, what minor adjustments can be made to help mitigate the warping? I'm keen to keep my skills sharp, even if the blade is not performing as it should.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Certainly, Lady Mitsuri. To help mitigate any warping, it would be best to regularly check the tightness of the blade's fittings, ensuring the handle and guard are secure. Keeping the blade well-oiled helps maintain its integrity. For immediate issues, using a sharpening stone to refine the edge might prevent further deformation during swings. While these solutions aren't a substitute for a full reforge, they could help sustain the sword's current condition until the master can tend to it personally.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

Please extend my regards to the master upon their return, and should there be any updates or alternative solutions in the interim, do not hesitate to contact me. May your work here be safe and productive until the master's return.
